EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Technical Support. We apologize for the issues you are experiencing with automatically signing out of the application. Modifying cookie handling settings in Google Chrome can resolve the issue, as can switching to another browser.
To fix the issue with Auto Logout in Google Chrome:
Launch Google Chrome
In the URL, type chrome://flags
In the Search, type Same
Enable SameSite by default cookies and Cookies without SameSite must be secure
Try accessing again
If this does not resolve the issues, please take the additional steps listed below to allow our sites to use cookies in Google Chrome.
Removing Block third-party cookies
Launch Google Chrome
Type chrome://settings/cookies in the address
Select Privacy and Security
If Block third-party cookies is blocked, try changing it to Block third-party cookies in Incognito
Under Sites that can always use cookies add Insperity.com and Orgplus.com
Have user try accessing again
If neither works, try Allow all cookies
Please call the support team at 877-222-0499 if additional guidance is needed.
